programme.title: Hindi Ako Ander, Tanong Mo Kay Kumander
Hindi Ako Ander, Tanong Mo Kay Kumander
The Mentalist S5 3
programme.desc: When a bank employee is murdered during a heist, Jane and the team get to work to track down the killer. Meanwhile, Lisbon is dragged deeper into the CBI/FBI rivalry.

programme.title: The Mentalist S5 4
programme.desc: When Rigsby's father (guest star WILLIAM FORSYTHE) is found injured at a crime scene, the team must find out if it is the result of a longstanding small-town gang war.

programme.title: Magnum Force
programme.desc: Academy Award winner Clint Eastwood stars as San Francisco Police Inspector Harry Callahan better known as \"Dirty Harry\" because of the tough way he pursues criminals in this bare-knuckled action film. Investigating the assassinations of crime bosses, Dirty Harry discovers the killers are police who, frustrated by the judicial system, have vowed to rid the city of crime by any means--even killing fellow police officers.

programme.title: Inception
programme.desc: Your mind is the scene of the crime. Box-office superstar Leonardo DiCaprio stars in this contemporary science fiction action film set \"within the architecture of the mind.\" Written, directed and produced by Oscar and Golden Globe nominee Christopher Nolan (The Dark Knight, Batman Begins, The Prestige), this eagerly awaited follow-up to 2008's billion-dollar blockbuster is yet another visionary tale from a startingly original filmmaker who continually raises the bar with every film he makes. Shooting in London, Paris, Tangiers, Calgary and Los Angeles, Nolan's mind-bending film also stars Academy Award winners Michael Caine and Marion Cotillard, in addition to Juno's Ellen Page, Batman Begins' Cillian Murphy and Oscar nominees Ken Watanabe (The Last Samurai) and Tom Berenger (Platoon).

programme.title: Wrath Of The Titans
programme.desc: Taking place 10 years after his heroic defeat of the Kraken, Perseus (Sam Worthington) embarks on a treacherous quest into the underworld to rescue his father, overthrow the Titans and save mankind.

programme.title: Full House S1 11
programme.desc: Danny arrives at his surprise 30th birthday party only to discover that Jesse has accidentally driven his prized car into the bay.

programme.title: Full House S1 12
programme.desc: Three grown men experiencing the \"joys of motherhood,\" as they raise three adorable girls in a Full House.

programme.title: Full House S1 13
programme.desc: Jesse suggests that D.J. audition for a commercial after she does well in a school performance. D.J. does well in her audition, but when she leaves the room, the part is given to Stephanie.

programme.title: Full House S1 14
programme.desc: Jesse uses baby Michelle to get a date with one of Danny's co-workers, but when a girlfriend of Jesse's tells the story of how she met Jesse with Michelle, Jesse's date is postponed indefinitely.

programme.title: Journey To The Center Of The Earth
programme.desc: During a scientific expedition to Iceland, scientist Trevor Anderson (Fraser-- Crash, The Mummy), his nephew Sean (Josh Hutcherson) and their local guide, Hannah (Anita Briem), are trapped in a cave -- from which their only escape is to go deeper, into unimagined worlds, where the trio comes face to face with never-before-seen creatures and harrowing dangers as they race an building volcanic eruption to reach the surface!

programme.title: Giant
programme.desc: Wealthy rancher Bick Benedict (Hudson) and dirt-poor cowboy Jett Rink (Dean) both woo Leslie Lynnton (Taylor) a beautiful young woman from Maryland who is new to Texas. She marries Benedict, but she is shocked by the racial bigotry of the White Texans against the local people of Mexican descent. Rink discovers oil on a small plot of land, and while he uses his vast, new wealth to buy all the land surrounding the Benedict ranch, the Benedict's disagreement over prejudice fuels conflict the runs across generations.

programme.title: Er S1 7
programme.desc: A drunk Chloe shows up in the hospital. Carol and Doug share a kiss. Benton and Langworthy are rivals for the Starzl fellowship.

programme.title: Er S1 8
programme.desc: Dr. Susan Lewis notices that Dr. Cvetic is ill-tempered lately. Benton has family problems. Carol takes care of a rape victim. Doug is overwhelmed by his position as acting chief.

programme.title: Full House S1 15
programme.desc: Danny is excited about the chance to play basketball with the Harlem Globetrotters, but when his family contracts chicken pox, finding a baby-sitter for Michelle seems impossible.

programme.title: Friends S5 4
programme.desc: The gang discovers that Phoebe hates PBS after Joey agrees to help out with a pledge drive. Emily tells Ross she'll give him a second chance only if he cuts all ties with Rachel.

programme.title: The Closer S7 16
programme.desc: Stroh (BILLY BURKE), but a shocking courtroom maneuver puts the case in jeopardy.

programme.title: The Closer S7 17
programme.desc: Provenza gets trapped into helping his first ex-wife, Liz (DIEDRE O'CONNELL -- \u003cI\u003eYou Don't Know Jack\u003c/i\u003e), recover her wedding ring after she is ripped off by a shady gold buyer.

programme.title: The Closer S7 18
programme.desc: A cancer doctor is brutally killed and his drug supply wiped clean. To make matters worse, Captain Raydor has a new assignment that leaves Brenda questioning her loyalty to Pope.

programme.title: The Closer S7 19
programme.desc: The murder of a priest drives a wedge between Brenda and Chief Pope. Meanwhile, Brenda's parents are in town while her father continues his cancer treatments.

programme.desc: Bidders go head to head in a battle over some super heavyweight freight, a can filled to the brim with outdoor adventure equipment contains a unique surprise, and a tailgaters dream could stop its winner short of the goal line.

programme.desc: The Israelis' go hard after what they think is vintage clothing, but will their fashion expertise pay off? Mo and Ty go postal when the doors swing open to reveal some mysterious machinery, and a custom container could land at least one buyer behindbars.

programme.desc: Dalam film nan penuh kejutan ini, Hobbs dan Shaw bekerja sama untuk menghentikan seorang penjahat super yang memiliki senjata biologis nan mematikan.

programme.title: The Man With The Iron Fists 2
programme.desc: Thaddeus diserang dalam perjalanannya ke Kuil Wu Chi, lalu diselamatkan oleh suatu pasangan yang mengobati lukanya dan menawarinya tempat tinggal. Namun, ia malah terlibat dalam konflik yang terjadi di wilayah mereka.

programme.title: Smurfs: The Lost Village
programme.desc: Smurfette dan Brainy, Clumsy, serta Hefty berada dalam sebuah perlombaan nan menebarkan dan menegangkan melalui Hutan Terlarang demi menemukan desa yang hilang.

programme.title: Backdraft 2
programme.desc: Sekuel dari film hit tahun 1991 tentang seorang penyelidik dengan Pemadam Kebakaran Chicago yang harus melacak seorang penjual senjata yang menggunakan kebakaran nan mematikan sebagai pengalih perhatian.

programme.title: Hard Target
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme harus memperdaya sebuah grup yang membunuh manusia demi kepuasan pribadi.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 7
programme.desc: Deckard Shaw berusaha membalaskan dendamnya kepada Dominic Toretto dan keluarganya untuk saudaranya yang sedang terbaring koma.

programme.title: Backdraft 2
programme.desc: Sekuel dari film hit tahun 1991 tentang seorang penyelidik dengan Pemadam Kebakaran Chicago yang harus melacak seorang penjual senjata yang menggunakan kebakaran nan mematikan sebagai pengalih perhatian.

programme.title: Pixels
programme.desc: Saksikan aksi petualangan spektakuler dari sekelompok mantan juara video gim dari tahun 1980-an yang bersatu untuk menyelamatkan dunia dari invasi alien.

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: Usai pindah ke kota baru, Daniel diganggu oleh beberapa anak laki-laki yang menguasai karate. Ia pun memutuskan untuk berlatih dari Tn. Miyagi. Kemudian, ia menyadari bahwa karate tak hanya sekadar seni bela diri.

programme.title: Shanghai
programme.desc: John Cusack berperan sebagai seorang pejabat intelijen Amerika yang kembali ke Shanghai pada akhir tahun 1941 guna menyelidiki kematian seorang teman. Hal ini membawanya pada cinta dan konspirasi yang jauh lebih besar.

programme.title: Sudden Death
programme.desc: Seorang petugas pemadam, Darren McCord, harus berpacu melawan waktu demi menyelamatkan putrinya, Wakil Presiden, dan seluruh penonton di stadion saat sekelompok teroris menguasai pertandingan final Liga Hoki Nasional.

programme.title: The Last Dragonslayer
programme.desc: Film fantasi petualangan ini berlatar di dunia tempat sihir digantikan oleh teknologi dan berkisah tentang seorang anak yatim piatu saat ia dengan enggan menemukan takdirnya untuk menjadi The Last Dragonslayer.

programme.desc: Nicholas bekerja sebagai dokter gigi di Kanada. Namun, ia menghadapi kesulitan kala mengetahui bahwa tetangga barunya adalah Jimmy Tudeski, seorang pembunuh bayaran yang juga dikenal sebagai Jimmy Si Tulip.

programme.title: Fallen
programme.desc: Detective John Hobbes witnesses the execution of a demonic serial killer, Edgar Reese. However, questions arise when the murders start again, eerily matching the modus operandi of Reese.

programme.title: Final Score
programme.desc: When two terrorists kidnap former soldier Michael Knox's niece, he employs all of his skills to rescue her and possibly foil a plan of mass destruction as well.

programme.title: The LEGO Movie 2: The Second Part
programme.desc: Five years after saving the Lego world, Emmet must once again save everyone with the help of Rex Dangervest when new enemies from outer space attack them.

programme.title: Justice League
programme.desc: Steppenwolf and his Parademons return after aeons to destroy Earth. However, Batman seeks the help of Wonder Woman to recruit The Flash, Cyborg and Aquaman to fight their new powerful enemy.

programme.title: Piranha 3D
programme.desc: An earthquake cracks open the bottom of a lake, releasing a prehistoric species of piranha. As sinister events unfold due to the flesh-eating fish, a group of strangers team up to stop the bloodbath.

programme.title: Rocky V
programme.desc: Circumstances force Rocky to retire from boxing. However, he soon accepts to train a young boxer named Tommy Gunn at his older trainer Mickey Goldmill's gym.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
programme.desc: After putting an end to the dystopian Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen and her friends attempt to rescue a brainwashed companion and free their nation from the control of President Coriolanus Snow.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: John, son of Sarah Connor, sends a reprogrammed Terminator to protect his younger self, who also holds the key to humanity's survival, from the T-1000, an advanced robot created by Skynet.

programme.title: GoldenEye
programme.desc: Agent 007, along with Natalia Simonav, travels to Russia to locate the satellite nuclear weapon stolen by Alec, a former agent, who Bond believed was dead.

programme.title: Set Up
programme.desc: After his friend betrays him and disappears with the stolen goods, Sonny seeks vengeance. Subsequently, he partners up with a dangerous mob boss to achieve his goal.

programme.title: Kung Fu Yoga
programme.desc: An archeology expert joins an Indian professor to look for a lost treasure of India. However, things take a dangerous turn when they are ambushed in their quest.

programme.title: Stars!
programme.desc: The host sheds light on various popular individuals from different walks of life and highlights their individual journeys to stardom.

programme.title: The Kid
programme.desc: After a woman abandons her child, the Tramp finds him and takes him under his wing. As the boy grows up, the Tramp and the boy try to cope with life's trials and tribulations.

programme.title: The Giver
programme.desc: Jonas, a young man, trains under an elder in order to become the keeper of his community's memories. However, things get complicated once he discovers the sinister side of his city.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: Courtney Collins, a single mother, relocates to a rural home with her twin sons. Later, she discovers it's inhabited by malevolent spirits connected to the sinister entity Bughuul.

programme.title: Edge of Tomorrow
programme.desc: With the help of warrior Rita Vrataski, Major William Cage has to save Earth and the human race from an alien species, after being caught in a time loop.
